```{r setup}
# pkg_path is the absolute path to the package root, passed by the driver
# script. This is required because the QMD may render in a temp directory
# where here::here() cannot locate the DESCRIPTION file.
pkg_root <- params$pkg_path

# Load package functions.
# If pkg_root contains a source-level DESCRIPTION + R/ directory (dev mode),
# use devtools::load_all(). Otherwise the package is installed — use library().
if (!is.null(pkg_root) &&
    file.exists(file.path(pkg_root, "DESCRIPTION")) &&
    file.exists(file.path(pkg_root, "R"))) {
  devtools::load_all(pkg_root)
} else {
  library(ReportR)
}

# Source the assessment spec — puts assessment_spec in scope.
spec_path <- if (file.exists(params$spec_file)) {
  params$spec_file
} else {
  file.path(pkg_root, params$spec_file)
}
source(spec_path)

# Load pre-computed results from RDS.
general_trend_results <- readRDS(params$results_file)
min_n <- general_trend_results$params$min_n

# report_years controls which years appear in main-body tables.
# NULL means show all years (no filtering).
report_years       <- params$report_years
report_years_label <- if (is.null(report_years)) "all years" else paste(range(report_years), collapse = "–")
```

## Introduction

```{r subtitle, results='asis'}
cat("###", assessment_spec$program$name, "\n")
```

This section presents general trend findings for `r assessment_spec$program$name`. Results are organized into four areas: (1) scale score trends over time, (2) proficiency trends, (3) score distribution patterns, and (4) achievement level transitions. All analyses exclude cells with fewer than `r min_n` students.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Scale Score Trends

### Mean Scale Scores Over Time

```{r score-narrative, results='asis'}
cat(general_trend_results$score_trends$text$narrative)
```

```{r tbl-score-trends, tab.cap="Mean Scale Scores and Standard Deviations by Year, Subject, and Grade"}
tbl      <- general_trend_results$score_trends$table   # kept full for diff computation below
tbl_disp <- tbl
if (!is.null(report_years)) {
  yr_pat   <- paste(as.character(report_years), collapse = "|")
  keep     <- c("SUBJECT", "GRADE", grep(yr_pat, names(tbl), value = TRUE))
  tbl_disp <- tbl[, keep]
}

mean_sd_cols <- grep("_(Mean|SD)$", names(tbl_disp), value = TRUE)

flextable::flextable(tbl_disp) |>
  flextable::bold(part = "header") |>
  flextable::fontsize(size = 9, part = "all") |>
  flextable::colformat_double(j = mean_sd_cols, digits = 2) |>
  flextable::set_table_properties(layout = "autofit", width = 1)
```

```{r tbl-score-changes, tab.cap="Year-to-Year Changes in Mean Scale Scores, Standard Deviations, and N by Subject and Grade"}
tbl_df <- as.data.frame(tbl)  # base R data frame avoids tibble [[<- compatibility errors
yrs    <- sort(as.integer(sub("_Mean$", "", grep("_Mean$", names(tbl_df), value = TRUE))))
if (!is.null(report_years)) yrs <- yrs[yrs %in% as.integer(unlist(report_years))]
y1s    <- head(yrs, -1L)
y2s    <- tail(yrs, -1L)
pairs  <- paste0(y1s, "→", y2s)

diff_tbl <- tbl_df[, c("SUBJECT", "GRADE"), drop = FALSE]
for (i in seq_along(pairs)) {
  c_m2 <- paste0(y2s[i], "_Mean"); c_m1 <- paste0(y1s[i], "_Mean")
  c_s2 <- paste0(y2s[i], "_SD");   c_s1 <- paste0(y1s[i], "_SD")
  c_n2 <- paste0(y2s[i], "_N");    c_n1 <- paste0(y1s[i], "_N")
  if (!c_m2 %in% names(tbl_df) || !c_m1 %in% names(tbl_df)) next
  diff_tbl[[paste0(pairs[i], "_ΔMean")]] <- round(tbl_df[[c_m2]] - tbl_df[[c_m1]], 2)
  diff_tbl[[paste0(pairs[i], "_ΔSD")]]   <- round(tbl_df[[c_s2]] - tbl_df[[c_s1]], 2)
  diff_tbl[[paste0(pairs[i], "_ΔN")]]    <- tbl_df[[c_n2]] - tbl_df[[c_n1]]
}

delta_mean_sd_cols <- grep("_Δ(Mean|SD)$", names(diff_tbl), value = TRUE)

if (nrow(diff_tbl) > 0 && length(delta_mean_sd_cols) > 0) {
  flextable::flextable(diff_tbl) |>
    flextable::bold(part = "header") |>
    flextable::fontsize(size = 9, part = "all") |>
    flextable::colformat_double(j = delta_mean_sd_cols, digits = 2) |>
    flextable::set_table_properties(layout = "autofit", width = 1)
} else {
  cat("*No year-to-year changes to display for the selected report years.*\n")
}
```

```{r mean-trend-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=5, results='asis'}
for (p in general_trend_results$score_trends$plot$mean_trend) {
  print(p)
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

```{r mean-sd-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=5, results='asis'}
for (p in general_trend_results$score_trends$plot$mean_sd) {
  print(p)
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

## Proficiency Trends

### Percent Proficient Over Time

```{r prof-narrative, results='asis'}
cat(general_trend_results$proficiency$text$narrative)
```

```{r tbl-proficiency, tab.cap="Percent Proficient and Student Counts by Year, Subject, and Grade"}
prof_tbl <- general_trend_results$proficiency$table
if (!is.null(report_years)) {
  prof_tbl <- prof_tbl |> dplyr::filter(.data[["YEAR"]] %in% report_years)
}

yr_order  <- sort(unique(prof_tbl$YEAR))
stat_cols <- as.vector(outer(yr_order, c("Pct", "N"), paste, sep = "_"))

display_tbl <- prof_tbl |>
  dplyr::mutate(pct_proficient = round(pct_proficient, 1)) |>
  dplyr::select(YEAR, SUBJECT, GRADE, Pct = pct_proficient, N = n) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c("Pct", "N"), names_to = "stat", values_to = "value") |>
  dplyr::mutate(col_name = paste(YEAR, stat, sep = "_")) |>
  dplyr::select(-YEAR, -stat) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = col_name, values_from = value) |>
  dplyr::select(SUBJECT, GRADE,
                dplyr::any_of(stat_cols)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(SUBJECT, GRADE)

flextable::flextable(display_tbl) |>
  flextable::bold(part = "header") |>
  flextable::fontsize(size = 9, part = "all") |>
  flextable::set_table_properties(layout = "autofit", width = 1)
```

```{r tbl-proficiency-changes, tab.cap="Year-to-Year Changes in Percent Proficient and Student Counts by Subject and Grade"}
disp_df <- as.data.frame(display_tbl)
py1s    <- head(yr_order, -1L)
py2s    <- tail(yr_order, -1L)
ppairs  <- paste0(py1s, "→", py2s)

prof_diff_tbl <- disp_df[, c("SUBJECT", "GRADE"), drop = FALSE]
for (i in seq_along(ppairs)) {
  c_p2 <- paste0(py2s[i], "_Pct"); c_p1 <- paste0(py1s[i], "_Pct")
  c_n2 <- paste0(py2s[i], "_N");   c_n1 <- paste0(py1s[i], "_N")
  if (!c_p2 %in% names(disp_df) || !c_p1 %in% names(disp_df)) next
  prof_diff_tbl[[paste0(ppairs[i], "_ΔPct")]] <- round(disp_df[[c_p2]] - disp_df[[c_p1]], 1)
  prof_diff_tbl[[paste0(ppairs[i], "_ΔN")]]   <- disp_df[[c_n2]] - disp_df[[c_n1]]
}

delta_pct_cols <- grep("_ΔPct$", names(prof_diff_tbl), value = TRUE)

if (nrow(prof_diff_tbl) > 0 && length(delta_pct_cols) > 0) {
  flextable::flextable(prof_diff_tbl) |>
    flextable::bold(part = "header") |>
    flextable::fontsize(size = 9, part = "all") |>
    flextable::colformat_double(j = delta_pct_cols, digits = 1) |>
    flextable::set_table_properties(layout = "autofit", width = 1)
} else {
  cat("*No year-to-year changes to display for the selected report years.*\n")
}
```

```{r prof-trend-plot, fig.width=9, fig.height=4}

if (!is.null(p)) print(p) else cat("*Proficiency trend data not available.*\n")
```

### Flagged Transitions

```{r transition-flags-narrative, results='asis'}
cat(general_trend_results$achievement_transitions$flags$narrative)
```

```{r transition-flags-table}
flags_tbl <- general_trend_results$achievement_transitions$flags$table
if (!is.null(report_years) && !is.null(flags_tbl)) {
  flags_tbl <- flags_tbl |> dplyr::filter(.data[["YEAR_2"]] %in% report_years)
}
if (!is.null(flags_tbl) && nrow(flags_tbl) > 0) {
  flextable::flextable(
    flags_tbl |>
      dplyr::select(subj_label, grade_lbl, YEAR_1, YEAR_2,
                    pct_up, pct_stable, pct_down, flag_type) |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        pct_up     = round(pct_up     * 100, 1),
        pct_stable = round(pct_stable * 100, 1),
        pct_down   = round(pct_down   * 100, 1)
      ) |>
      dplyr::rename(`Subject` = subj_label, `Grade` = grade_lbl,
                    `Year 1` = YEAR_1, `Year 2` = YEAR_2,
                    `% Up` = pct_up, `% Stable` = pct_stable,
                    `% Down` = pct_down, `Flag` = flag_type)
  ) |>
    flextable::bold(part = "header") |>
    flextable::fontsize(size = 9, part = "all") |>
    flextable::bg(bg = "#fce8b2", part = "body") |>
    flextable::set_table_properties(layout = "autofit", width = 1)
}
```

```{r transition-cell-flags-table}
cell_flags <- general_trend_results$achievement_transitions$flags$table_cells
if (!is.null(report_years) && !is.null(cell_flags)) {
  cell_flags <- cell_flags |> dplyr::filter(.data[["YEAR_2"]] %in% report_years)
}
if (!is.null(cell_flags) && nrow(cell_flags) > 0) {
  flextable::flextable(
    cell_flags |>
      dplyr::select(subj_label, grade_lbl, YEAR_1, YEAR_2,
                    from_level, to_level, prop, mean_prop, flag_dir) |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        prop      = round(prop      * 100, 1),
        mean_prop = round(mean_prop * 100, 1)
      ) |>
      dplyr::rename(`Subject` = subj_label, `Grade` = grade_lbl,
                    `Year 1` = YEAR_1, `Year 2` = YEAR_2,
                    `From Level` = from_level, `To Level` = to_level,
                    `% Observed` = prop, `% Typical` = mean_prop,
                    `Flag` = flag_dir)
  ) |>
    flextable::bold(part = "header") |>
    flextable::fontsize(size = 9, part = "all") |>
    flextable::bg(bg = "#fce8b2", part = "body") |>
    flextable::set_table_properties(layout = "autofit", width = 1)
}
```

# Appendix: Historical Data (All Years)

```{r appendix-note, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(report_years)) {
  all_years  <- sort(unique(general_trend_results$proficiency$table$YEAR))
  hist_years <- setdiff(all_years, report_years)
  if (length(hist_years) > 0) {
    cat("*Main report sections above show data for", report_years_label, "only.",
        "Full data for all available years is shown below and exported to Excel.*\n\n")
  } else {
    cat("*No historical years outside the report window. All available years are shown in the main body.*\n\n")
    knitr::knit_exit()
  }
} else {
  cat("*All available years are shown in the main body. No appendix data.*\n\n")
  knitr::knit_exit()
}
```

## A.2 Proficiency — All Years

```{r appendix-proficiency}
full_prof <- general_trend_results$proficiency$table
yr_order_full  <- sort(unique(full_prof$YEAR))
stat_cols_full <- as.vector(outer(yr_order_full, c("Pct", "N"), paste, sep = "_"))

full_display <- full_prof |>
  dplyr::mutate(pct_proficient = round(pct_proficient, 1)) |>
  dplyr::select(YEAR, SUBJECT, GRADE, Pct = pct_proficient, N = n) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c("Pct", "N"), names_to = "stat", values_to = "value") |>
  dplyr::mutate(col_name = paste(YEAR, stat, sep = "_")) |>
  dplyr::select(-YEAR, -stat) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = col_name, values_from = value) |>
  dplyr::select(SUBJECT, GRADE, dplyr::any_of(stat_cols_full)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(SUBJECT, GRADE)

flextable::flextable(full_display) |>
  flextable::bold(part = "header") |>
  flextable::fontsize(size = 9, part = "all") |>
  flextable::set_table_properties(layout = "autofit", width = 1)
```
